name: sharek-backend
description: Share-k NestJS backend using a feature-first modular monolith.

scripts.start:dev: sh -c 'if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then : ${DATABASE_URL:=postgresql://sharek:sharek@postgres:5432/sharek?schema=public}; else : ${DATABASE_URL:=postgresql://sharek:sharek@localhost:${POSTGRES_PORT:-5433}/sharek?schema=public}; fi; export DATABASE_URL; nest start --watch'
scripts.prisma:migrate: sh -c 'if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then : ${DATABASE_URL:=postgresql://sharek:sharek@postgres:5432/sharek?schema=public}; else : ${DATABASE_URL:=postgresql://sharek:sharek@localhost:${POSTGRES_PORT:-5433}/sharek?schema=public}; fi; export DATABASE_URL; prisma migrate dev'
scripts.prisma:studio: sh -c 'if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then : ${DATABASE_URL:=postgresql://sharek:sharek@postgres:5432/sharek?schema=public}; else : ${DATABASE_URL:=postgresql://sharek:sharek@localhost:${POSTGRES_PORT:-5433}/sharek?schema=public}; fi; export DATABASE_URL; prisma studio'
